description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultChannelIdMapper class, which implements the IChannelIdMapper interface to map stream IDs to grain keys based on binding properties and specific key types (GUID, Int64).

classes.name: DefaultChannelIdMapper
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IChannelIdMapper for mapping stream IDs to grain keys based on binding properties.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Determines the grain key ID span based on grain bindings and stream ID, handling GUID, Int64, or default string keys.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Generates a GUID-based grain key, optionally including the namespace in the key.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Generates an integer-based grain key, optionally including the namespace in the key.
